posts.name: Alex
posts.cooked:
VisforYoshi:

 

Alex wrote:
I have to say, >G is really giving Alex Hirsch a run for his money.
Ah, a fellow Gravity Falls fan, I take it?

Very. For those who don't know, the creator of Gravity Falls loves hiding codes and secrets in everything. The title sequence contains a hidden backwards message giving keys to codes in the current episode, while other ciphers, to the best of my knowledge, don't even HAVE any hidden key; you have to crack them using real cryptography techniques. The codes in the current season use a keyed Vigenere cipher, virtually impossible to decode unless you find the keyword hidden in the background of each episode.  At one point he even went so far as to post  fake "leaked" footage to 4chan  just so people trying to guess  who was behind the biggest GF mystery of all would get thrown  off the trail.
